s:fukuoka/dazaifu-tenmangu: The vermilion arched drum bridges over the shrine pond at Dazaifu Tenmangu, plum trees in full white and pink bloom on the banks, stone lanterns, soft late-February morning light, calm water reflections, a few small distant visitors.
s:fukuoka/kushida-shrine: Kushida Shrine grounds: a towering decorated Hakata Gion Yamakasa float over ten metres high, crowded with colourful doll figures of warriors, castles and crashing waves, displayed under a roof beside the dark wooden shrine buildings, seen from a distance, soft daylight.
s:fukuoka/ohori-maizuru: Cherry blossoms at the Fukuoka Castle ruins: massive grey stone walls of the old castle with a white turret, trees in full pale pink bloom along the moat, soft lanterns just lit, early-evening blue sky, a few small distant visitors.
s:fukuoka/mojiko-retro: Mojiko Retro waterfront at blue hour: red-brick early twentieth-century Western-style buildings along a calm harbour basin, a pedestrian drawbridge, the Kanmon Strait beyond, warm lights reflecting in the water, deep blue sky.
s:fukuoka/yanagawa: Yanagawa canal: a flat-bottomed wooden boat poled by a boatman in a straw hat, seen from behind, gliding along a narrow canal lined with weeping willows, old stone walls and tiled-roof houses, small distant passengers, calm green water, soft spring sunlight.
s:fukuoka/kawachi-fujien: Inside the wisteria tunnel at Kawachi Fujien: a long arched tunnel completely draped with hanging clusters of purple, lavender, pink and white wisteria flowers, a path running through it, soft dappled late-April light, a few small distant visitors.
s:fukuoka/itoshima-futamigaura: Sakurai Futamigaura at sunset: a white torii standing in the shallow surf before two rocks in the sea joined by a thick shimenawa rope, the sun setting between them over the Genkai Sea, calm golden water, clear summer evening.
s:fukuoka/akizuki: Akizuki in early April: the straight Sugi-no-baba lane lined with cherry trees forming a pale pink tunnel, old stone walls and a dark wooden castle gate ahead, soft morning light, a few small distant visitors.
f:fukuoka/hakata-ramen: A bowl of Hakata tonkotsu ramen: creamy opaque white pork-bone broth with thin straight noodles, thin chashu slices, chopped green onion, kikurage strips and pink pickled ginger, in a black bowl on a wooden counter, 45-degree angle, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:fukuoka/motsunabe: Motsunabe in a shallow metal pot: plump beef intestines in soy broth under a mound of green garlic chives, cabbage, thin garlic slices and red chilli rings, simmering and steaming on a tabletop burner, 45-degree angle, warm izakaya light, shallow depth of field.
f:fukuoka/mizutaki: Hakata mizutaki in a clay pot: milky white chicken broth with bone-in chicken pieces, cabbage, leeks, tofu and mushrooms, a small bowl of ponzu with green onion beside, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft warm light, rising steam.
f:fukuoka/yatai: Riverside yatai stalls in Nakasu at night: a row of small wooden food stalls with warm glowing lanterns and fabric curtains, steam rising, building lights reflecting in the Naka River, a few small distant diners on stools, deep blue evening sky.
f:fukuoka/mentaiko: Mentaiko: a pair of glossy red-orange spicy marinated pollock roe sacs on a small ceramic plate, one sliced to show the tiny grains, beside a bowl of white rice and nori, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:saga/mifuneyama-rakuen: Mifuneyama Rakuen in late autumn: a still pond reflecting brilliant red and orange maples, the sheer grey cliffs of Mount Mifune rising behind, a small wooden pavilion at the water's edge, soft clear afternoon light.
s:saga/takeo-onsen: Takeo Onsen Romon Gate: a two-storey vermilion-lacquered wooden gate with a curved roof of grey tiles, standing at the entrance to the old public bathhouse, stone pavement in front, clear blue sky, soft morning light, no people.
s:saga/ureshino-onsen: Ureshino Onsen at dusk: a quiet hot-spring street beside the Ureshino River, low traditional inns and a stone foot bath with light steam rising, warm street lamps glowing, green hills behind, deep blue sky.
s:saga/arita: A tonbai-bei wall lane in Arita: an old wall built from reddish fire-bricks and broken kiln pieces set in clay, a narrow path between houses and trees, mossy edges, soft overcast light, quiet, no people.
s:saga/yoshinogari: Yoshinogari Historical Park: reconstructed Yayoi-period thatched pit dwellings, raised-floor storehouses and a tall wooden watchtower inside a wooden palisade and moat, wide green lawns, clear blue sky, bright midday sunlight, a few small distant visitors.
s:saga/yutoku-inari: Yutoku Inari Shrine: a vermilion-lacquered main hall perched high on a tall wooden scaffold of pillars and beams against a forested hillside, steep stone stairs below, lush green trees, bright clear day, a few small distant visitors.
s:saga/karatsu-castle: Karatsu Castle on its seaside hill seen from across the river mouth: a white multi-tiered keep with grey tiled roofs above stone walls and green pines, overlooking Karatsu Bay and a long pale beach, calm blue water, bright clear morning.
s:saga/yobuko-morning-market: Yobuko Morning Market: a short street of simple stalls with tables of dried split squid, dried fish, sea urchin and fresh fruit, a small fishing harbour at the end, soft early-morning light, a few small distant shoppers.
f:saga/yobuko-squid: Yobuko squid ikizukuri: a whole translucent squid sliced into glassy clear strips and arranged on its body over shredded daikon and ice, tentacles intact, on a large ceramic plate with wasabi and soy sauce, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:saga/saga-beef: Thick cubes of finely marbled Saga beef seared medium-rare on a teppanyaki griddle, pink centres showing, with crisp fried garlic chips, bean sprouts and a little dish of salt beside, 45-degree angle, warm restaurant light, shallow depth of field.
f:saga/onsen-yudofu: Ureshino onsen yudofu: soft blocks of tofu simmering in a clay pot of milky white hot-spring broth, edges melting into the liquid, a small dish of sesame sauce and green onion beside, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft light, rising steam.
f:saga/sicilian-rice: Saga Sicilian rice on a white oval plate: white rice topped with sweet-savoury stir-fried thin meat slices, shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and cucumber, finished with a zigzag of mayonnaise, on a cafe table, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:nagasaki/glover-garden: The former Glover House in Glover Garden: a white single-storey wooden colonial-style house with a wide veranda and a grey tiled roof, surrounded by flowerbeds and palm trees, Nagasaki harbour and green hills behind, bright spring sunlight, clear sky.
s:nagasaki/peace-park: The Nagasaki Peace Statue: a huge seated bronze male figure, right hand pointing to the sky and left arm stretched out horizontally, on a stone pedestal at the end of a long paved plaza, trees on both sides, clear summer morning sky, seen from a distance.
s:nagasaki/inasayama: Night view from the Mount Inasa observation deck: the lights of Nagasaki filling the bowl-shaped valley around the deep harbour, an illuminated cable-stayed bridge, hillsides glowing with homes, deep blue twilight sky just after sunset, clear air.
s:nagasaki/gunkanjima: Hashima (Gunkanjima) seen from a tour boat: a small island completely enclosed by a high concrete sea wall and densely packed with ruined grey concrete apartment blocks, resembling a battleship on the water, calm blue sea, soft overcast light.
s:nagasaki/dejima: Reconstructed Dejima: a row of two-storey Edo-period buildings with white plaster walls, dark wooden shutters and grey tiled roofs along a narrow paved street, a pale Western-style building at the end, soft clear afternoon light, a few small distant visitors.
s:nagasaki/huis-ten-bosch: Huis Ten Bosch in spring: a classic Dutch windmill beside a calm canal, vast beds of red, yellow, pink and white tulips in front, brick gabled buildings in the distance, bright blue sky, soft morning sunlight.
s:nagasaki/kujukushima: View from Tenkaiho observatory over Kujukushima at sunset: dozens of small forested islands scattered across calm silver-gold water and layered into the distance, oyster rafts in the sheltered bays, warm orange sky, soft haze.
s:nagasaki/unzen-onsen: Unzen Jigoku: white volcanic steam billowing from vents across barren pale yellow-white sulphurous ground, a wooden boardwalk winding through, pine trees and autumn-coloured hills behind, soft overcast morning light, a few small distant walkers.
f:nagasaki/champon: A large bowl of Nagasaki champon: thick noodles in milky white pork and chicken broth, piled with stir-fried cabbage, bean sprouts, pork, shrimp, squid, pink-and-white kamaboko and snow peas, in a wide ceramic bowl, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, light steam.
f:nagasaki/sara-udon: Sara udon: a nest of crisp fried thin noodles on a large oval plate, covered with a glossy thick sauce of cabbage, pork, shrimp, squid, kamaboko and vegetables, a small jug of sauce beside, overhead angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:nagasaki/castella: Slices of Nagasaki castella sponge cake with a bright yellow crumb, a dark brown top crust and coarse sugar crystals on the bottom, on a small plate with a cup of green tea, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:nagasaki/turkish-rice: Nagasaki Turkish rice on a large oval plate: a breaded pork cutlet with demi-glace sauce, a mound of pilaf, spaghetti napolitan and a small salad, on a cafe table, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:nagasaki/sasebo-burger: A tall Sasebo burger half-wrapped in plain paper: a sesame bun stacked with a thick beef patty, bacon, fried egg, lettuce, tomato and onion, served on a tray with fries at a small diner counter, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:kumamoto/kumamoto-castle: Kumamoto Castle in spring: the large and small black keeps with white trim and layered grey tiled roofs atop steeply curving stone walls, cherry trees in full pink bloom in the foreground, clear blue sky, bright midday sunlight.
s:kumamoto/suizenji: Suizenji Jojuen Garden: a small grassy mound shaped like Mount Fuji beside a crystal-clear spring-fed pond with orange koi, stone bridges and clipped pines, a thatched teahouse on the bank, soft morning light, gentle reflections.
s:kumamoto/aso-nakadake: Mount Aso Nakadake seen from a distance: a barren grey volcanic crater rim with a white steam plume rising, rugged ash slopes and the green grassy Aso highlands around, clear blue sky, bright morning light.
s:kumamoto/kusasenri: Kusasenri meadow in early summer: a vast round green grassy plain with a shallow pond in the centre, a few horses grazing, the volcanic cone of Nakadake behind with a white steam plume rising, clear blue sky, soft morning light.
s:kumamoto/daikanbo: View from Daikanbo over the Aso caldera at dawn: a sea of white clouds filling the vast caldera basin, the jagged Aso Five Peaks rising above it on the horizon, green grassy outer rim in the foreground, pale gold sunrise light.
s:kumamoto/kurokawa-onsen: Kurokawa Onsen in winter: a small stream flowing through a narrow wooded valley, wooden ryokan and stone walls along both banks under fresh snow, warm lamps glowing, steam rising from open-air baths, soft blue evening light.
s:kumamoto/kamishikimi-kumanoimasu: Kamishikimi Kumanoimasu Shrine: a long stone stairway climbing through dense cedar forest, lined with moss-covered stone lanterns and small torii, every surface vivid green with moss after rain, misty diffused light, no people.
s:kumamoto/kikuchi-gorge: Kikuchi Gorge in mid-November: a clear shallow stream cascading over smooth rocks in small waterfalls, maple trees in brilliant red and orange overhead, sunbeams filtering through the forest onto the water, soft morning light.
f:kumamoto/basashi: Basashi: thin slices of deep red lean horse meat and pink marbled cuts fanned out on a ceramic plate with shredded onion, grated ginger, garlic and shiso leaves, a dish of sweet soy sauce beside, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:kumamoto/kumamoto-ramen: A bowl of Kumamoto ramen: cloudy pork-bone broth with medium-thick straight noodles, dark garlic oil swirled on top, crisp fried garlic chips, chashu, kikurage strips and green onion, in a white ceramic bowl, 45-degree angle, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:kumamoto/taipien: A bowl of Kumamoto taipien: glass vermicelli noodles in light chicken-seafood broth, topped with shrimp, pork, cabbage, wood ear mushroom and halves of a fried boiled egg with golden-brown skin, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, light steam.
f:kumamoto/akaushi: Aso akaushi beef bowl: thin slices of rosy medium-rare lean beef fanned over rice in a ceramic bowl, topped with a raw egg yolk and chopped green onion, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:oita/beppu-jigoku: Umi Jigoku in Beppu: a steaming hot-spring pond of vivid cobalt-blue water edged with rocks and green trees, thick white steam drifting across the surface, soft clear morning light, a few small distant visitors.
s:oita/kannawa-onsen: Kannawa Onsen at dusk seen from a hillside: white steam rising from vents and chimneys between old tiled roofs, narrow sloping lanes, warm street lamps, deep blue sky, the whole town wrapped in drifting plumes.
s:oita/takegawara-onsen: Takegawara Onsen: a dark wooden Meiji-era bathhouse with a grand curved karahafu gable roof of grey tiles and a lantern-lit entrance, on a narrow old street, soft evening light, quiet, no people.
s:oita/yufuin: Lake Kinrin in Yufuin on a late-autumn morning: white mist rising from the warm lake surface, trees in red and yellow around the shore, a small torii standing in the water, twin-peaked Mount Yufu behind, soft early light.
s:oita/usa-jingu: Usa Jingu: vermilion-lacquered main shrine halls with white walls and dark curved roofs behind a vermilion gate, surrounded by tall camphor and cedar trees, gravel grounds, soft morning light, a few small distant visitors.
s:oita/yabakei: Hitome Hakkei in Yabakei Gorge from an elevated viewpoint: towering jagged volcanic rock pinnacles rising above forested slopes blazing with red, orange and yellow autumn maples, clear blue sky, crisp morning light.
s:oita/kokonoe-yume-bridge: Kokonoe Yume Otsurihashi: a long slender pedestrian suspension bridge spanning a deep forested gorge, a tall waterfall pouring down one side, autumn foliage in red, orange and gold across the valley, clear blue sky, small distant walkers on the bridge.
f:oita/jigoku-mushi: Jigoku-mushi: a bamboo steaming basket filled with steamed crab, shrimp, scallops, corn, sweet potato, pumpkin and eggs, wisps of hot-spring steam rising, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:oita/toriten: Oita toriten: light golden battered chicken tempura pieces piled on a plate with shredded cabbage, a small dish of vinegar-soy sauce with a dab of yellow mustard beside, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:oita/dango-jiru: A bowl of Oita dango-jiru: long flat hand-stretched wheat noodles in miso soup with taro, carrot, daikon, burdock, shiitake and green onion, in an earthenware bowl on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, rising steam.
f:oita/beppu-reimen: A bowl of Beppu reimen: thick chewy buckwheat-blend noodles in a clear chilled broth, topped with red kimchi, sliced chashu, half a boiled egg, sesame and green onion, in a large ceramic bowl, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:miyazaki/takachiho-gorge: Takachiho Gorge from a rowing boat: vertical columnar basalt cliffs rising on both sides of a narrow emerald-green river, the slender white Manai Falls pouring from the cliff top into the water, ferns and green foliage, soft diffused light, small distant rowboats.
s:miyazaki/takachiho-shrine: Takachiho Shrine: a dark wooden shrine hall framed by towering ancient cedar trees, stone lanterns and a gravel path, a pair of cedars joined at the base beside the path, misty soft morning light, quiet, no people.
s:miyazaki/amano-iwato: Amano Yasugawara: a huge cave in a forested riverside cliff with a small torii at its mouth, its floor covered with countless small stacked stone cairns, a clear shallow river in front, soft green diffused light, quiet.
s:miyazaki/aoshima: Aoshima Island at low tide: a small round island dense with green subtropical palms, ringed by the Devil's Washboard, long parallel ridges of wave-cut rock stretching into the sea, a footbridge from the shore, bright summer sunshine, clear blue sky.
s:miyazaki/udo-jingu: Udo Jingu: a vermilion-lacquered shrine hall built inside a large seaside cave at the foot of a cliff, rugged dark rocks and Pacific waves below, stone steps leading down, bright clear morning, deep blue sea.
s:miyazaki/obi: The Otemon gate in Obi: a large reconstructed wooden castle gate with a grey tiled roof above mossy stone walls, broad moss-covered stone steps and tall cedar and maple trees, soft green filtered light after rain, no people.
s:miyazaki/toi-misaki: Cape Toi: wild Misaki horses grazing on grassy slopes along the cliffs, the vast blue Pacific Ocean behind, a white lighthouse on the headland in the distance, bright clear spring afternoon.
f:miyazaki/chicken-nanban: Chicken nanban: thick slices of golden egg-battered fried chicken glazed in sweet vinegar sauce, generously topped with creamy chunky tartar sauce, shredded cabbage and tomato on the side, a bowl of rice beside, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:miyazaki/jidori-sumibiyaki: Miyazaki jidori sumibiyaki: bite-sized pieces of local chicken charred black and smoky, served on a small iron plate with sliced cucumber and a dab of yuzu kosho, a hint of smoke, warm izakaya light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
f:miyazaki/hiyajiru: Miyazaki hiyajiru: chilled pale miso soup with floating cucumber slices, crumbled tofu, shiso and sesame in a ceramic bowl, a bowl of barley rice beside, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, bright summer natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:miyazaki/miyazaki-mango: A ripe Miyazaki mango with deep red glossy skin, one half scored and pushed out into cubes showing vivid orange flesh, on a white plate on a light wooden table, 45-degree angle, bright summer daylight, shallow depth of field.
s:kagoshima/sakurajima: Sakurajima seen across Kinko Bay: a massive grey-green volcanic cone with a plume of ash and steam rising from its summit, a ferry crossing the calm blue bay in the foreground, clear blue sky, bright morning light.
s:kagoshima/sengan-en: Sengan-en garden: manicured lawns, pines and stone lanterns in the foreground, smoking Sakurajima across blue Kinko Bay as a borrowed backdrop, traditional villa roofs to one side, clear blue sky, soft morning light.
s:kagoshima/shiroyama: View from Shiroyama Observatory at dusk: Kagoshima city lights spread below, Kinko Bay beyond, the dark silhouette of Sakurajima with a faint plume against a pink and deep blue sky, subtropical trees framing the foreground.
s:kagoshima/ibusuki-sand-bath: Ibusuki sand bath on the beach, seen from a distance: rows of small figures in cotton yukata buried in dark volcanic sand up to their necks under a simple shelter, steam rising from the sand, calm sea beyond, soft morning light.
s:kagoshima/chiran: A Chiran samurai residence garden: neatly clipped sculpted hedges and stone arrangements behind a low stone wall, a traditional house with a grey tiled roof, a distant mountain as a borrowed backdrop, soft overcast light, no people.
s:kagoshima/kirishima-jingu: Kirishima Jingu in autumn: ornate vermilion shrine halls with black and gold details and carvings, surrounded by tall cedars and red maple leaves, a wide stone stairway leading up, soft clear morning light, a few small distant visitors.
s:kagoshima/shiratani-unsuikyo: Shiratani Unsuikyo moss forest on Yakushima: ancient twisted cedar trunks, roots and boulders all carpeted in thick vivid green moss, a small clear stream and ferns, soft misty diffused light after rain, deep quiet forest.
s:kagoshima/jomon-sugi: Jomon Sugi on Yakushima: an enormous ancient cedar with a massive, gnarled, deeply furrowed trunk and twisting branches, seen from the wooden viewing deck, surrounded by mossy forest, soft diffused misty light, a few tiny people for scale.
f:kagoshima/kurobuta: Kurobuta shabu-shabu: thin pink slices of Kagoshima black pork with white fat edges arranged on a large plate, a hot pot of simmering broth with vegetables beside, a dish of ponzu, on a dark wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:kagoshima/shirokuma: Kagoshima shirokuma: a large bowl of shaved ice drenched in condensed milk, topped with colourful fruit and sweet beans arranged so it resembles a bear's face from above, on a cafe table, overhead angle, bright summer daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:kagoshima/kagoshima-ramen: A bowl of Kagoshima ramen: semi-cloudy pork and chicken bone broth with medium-thick noodles, chashu, bean sprouts, green onion and fried onion, a small dish of pickled daikon beside, in a ceramic bowl on a wooden counter, 45-degree angle, warm light.
f:kagoshima/satsuma-age: Assorted freshly fried satsuma-age fish cakes: golden-brown round and oval patties, some studded with vegetables, one cut open showing a soft white interior, on a ceramic plate, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:kagoshima/imo-shochu: A traditional black earthenware kuro-joka pot beside a small cup of warm shochu cut with hot water, a plate of satsuma-age and a dish of black pork, on a wooden izakaya counter, soft warm light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
